comment: One call's worst-case cost, held to the same numbers by ceilingCostFor (src/lib/discovery/extract/estimate.ts) and by discovery_extract_ceiling_usd (supabase/migrations/20261021190000). tests/discovery/extract-run.test.ts checks the TS side and that supabase/tests/discovery_milestones.sql asserts each expectedCeilingUsd literal. ceiling = round(ceil((overheadBytes + subjectBytes + bodyBytes) / bytesPerToken) * inputUsdPerToken + outputCeilingUsd, 6). Prices are the pinned model's: $2 and $10 per million tokens, 2048 output tokens.
